Home.title: Konnected
Home.lede: Short project assignments for students and startups. Konnected approves every project and matches the students.
Home.placeholder: This page is a placeholder. The dashboards come in later steps.

ChooseRole.title: How will you use Konnected?
ChooseRole.lede: Signed in as {email}. Pick the option that fits. Konnected checks every student profile and every company before they take part.
ChooseRole.student1: Build a profile and upload your CV
ChooseRole.student2: Apply to projects Konnected has approved
ChooseRole.student3: Deliver through Konnected, and on paid projects get paid through Konnected
ChooseRole.company2: Submit a project with a clear deliverable, paid or unpaid
ChooseRole.company3: Konnected finds the student and releases the result to you

Entry.title: Short, real projects for university students
Entry.lede: Startups send in a project, paid or unpaid. Konnected decides if it goes ahead, picks a student and handles any payment.
Entry.factReview: Konnected reviews every company and every student profile.
Entry.factPrivacy: Companies never browse students. They see only what a selected student agreed to share.
Entry.factCoordinate: Konnected coordinates the work and the payment.
Entry.tabsLabel: Sign in or create an account
Entry.teamGoogle: Konnected team members sign in with Google.
Entry.ruleBreach: Checked against known data breaches when you save
Entry.confirmFirst: We email you a link to confirm your address before your first sign-in.
Entry.linkSentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. Open it on this device. It works once and expires in 15 minutes.
Entry.spamHint: Nothing in your inbox? Look in your spam folder.
Entry.verifySentBody: We sent a message to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm your address. After that you can sign in with your password.
Entry.verifySentNote: You cannot sign in with a password before you confirm your email.

AuthErrors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like name@example.no.
AuthErrors.breached: This password has appeared in a data breach. Choose another one.
AuthErrors.signInFailed: Email or password is not right.
AuthErrors.signInFailedHint: After 5 wrong tries sign-in is paused for 15 minutes.
AuthErrors.locked: After 5 wrong passwords, sign-in is paused for 15 minutes. You can wait, or sign in with an email link instead.
AuthErrors.unverified: We sent you a new link. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.
AuthErrors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
AuthErrors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

MagicLink.title: Sign in to Konnected
MagicLink.lede: Press the button to finish signing in. The link works once.
MagicLink.expiredLede: Sign-in links work once, and only for 15 minutes. Ask for a new one.

Verify.title: Confirm your email
Verify.lede: Press the button to confirm this address for your Konnected account.
Verify.doneLede: You can sign in with your password now.
Verify.invalidLede: It may have been used already. Try to sign in. If your email still needs confirming, we send you a new link.

Reset.askLede: Enter the email you signed up with. If it matches an account, we send a link to set a new password.
Reset.sentLede: If an account exists for {email}, we sent a link to set a new password. The link works once and expires in about an hour.
Reset.sentNote: This message is the same for every address, so nobody can use this page to find out who has an account.
Reset.newLede: Choose a password of at least {min} characters. A phrase of several words works well, and you can paste from a password manager.
Reset.doneLede: You can sign in with your new password now. Any other devices were signed out.
Reset.invalidLede: Reset links work once, and for about an hour. Ask for a new one.

common.linkFallback: If the button does not work, copy this address into your browser:
common.footer: Konnected, konnected.no. You get this email because this address was used on the Konnected sign-in page.

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Konnected
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Confirm your address to finish creating your Konnected account. After that you can sign in with your password.
verify.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email. The account cannot be used without this step.

magicLink.subject: Your Konnected sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Konnected
magicLink.body: Use the button to sign in to Konnected. The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
magicLink.ignore: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email. Nobody can sign in without the link.

accountExists.subject: You already have a Konnected account
accountExists.heading: You already have an account
accountExists.body: Someone tried to create a new Konnected account with this address. You already have one, so nothing was changed.
accountExists.howTo: Sign in with Google, with an email sign-in link, or with your password. If you forgot your password, choose “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.
accountExists.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.

team.heading: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google
team.link: Someone asked for a sign-in link for this address.
team.signup: Someone tried to create an account with this address.
team.reset: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account.
team.google: Konnected team accounts sign in with Google only, so no link was sent and nothing has changed.
team.ignore: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your Konnected password
reset.heading: Choose a new password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for this Konnected account. Use the button within an hour. The link works once.
reset.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password has not changed.
